caption:
This sentence says the TEST studied for weeks.

An opening phrase describes whatever comes right after the comma. Ask who did it, and put them there: "Having studied for weeks, Maya found the test easy."

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.
tiktok_caption: This sentence says the test studied for weeks. Put the person who did it right after the comma.

youtube.title: SAT Grammar: The Dangling Modifier Trap
youtube.description: Dangling modifiers on the SAT: an opening phrase has to describe the noun right after the comma.
